fact: As of 18 September 2024 the Sudan police electronic reporting platform held 43,960 missing-vehicle reports, 16,474 property-offence reports, 226 missing-person reports and 57 offences-against-the-person reports, and the police presidency said a criminal case begins with a report made at a police station or through the platform.
title: الشرطة تضيف خاصية جديدة للبلاغ الالكتروني
